label: s9-c517-conversation-runtime

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-00-002 Conversation and Message records survive a restart and a reconnect
assertionCoverage.clause: Conversation and Message records survive reconnect and restart.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The route test creates records through HTTP, closes the first server and store, opens the same on-disk database in a new store, and asserts the restored Message count.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-00-002 Conversation and Message records survive a restart and a reconnect
assertionCoverage.clause: Message identity and order remain stable across a real restart.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The assertion compares the records read through the restarted HTTP server with the records read before shutdown.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-00-002 Conversation and Message records survive a restart and a reconnect
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(message.content, before.messages[index]!.content, 'the Message content is intact');
assertionCoverage.clause: Persisted Message content is unchanged after restart.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The restarted route response is compared to the pre-restart content for every restored Message.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-00-002 Conversation and Message records survive a restart and a reconnect
assertionCoverage.clause: The restarted store lists the original Conversation.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The assertion reads the Conversation collection from the restarted store through HTTP and matches the original persisted identity.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-11-001 / LITE-09-001 / LITE-02-001 a Message-only Turn creates no Task and no Run
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(countRows('tasks'), 0, 'LITE-09-001: a Message-only Turn creates no Task');
assertionCoverage.clause: A Message-only Turn creates no Task.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production conversation route streams a Message-only Turn and then reads the durable tasks table, which remains empty.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-11-001 / LITE-09-001 / LITE-02-001 a Message-only Turn creates no Task and no Run
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(countRows('runs'), 0, 'LITE-09-001: a Message-only Turn creates no Run');
assertionCoverage.clause: A Message-only Turn creates no Run.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The same real HTTP Turn is followed by a direct durable runs-table count, proving no Run was created by the message-only path.

assertionCoverage.name: create-task and start-run bridge a Message into durable work
assertionCoverage.clause: The Task is a distinct durable object linked to the source Message.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production create-task endpoint returns a persisted Task whose source identity is checked against the created Message.

assertionCoverage.name: create-task and start-run bridge a Message into durable work
assertionCoverage.clause: Run creation is distinct and linked to the existing Task.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production start-run endpoint returns a Run whose taskId is compared with the previously persisted Task id.

assertionCoverage.name: create-task and start-run bridge a Message into durable work
assertionCoverage.clause: A retried start-run request does not create another Run.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production bridge is invoked a second time and its response explicitly reports that no new Run was created.

assertionCoverage.name: direct Conversation lifecycle: create, send, list, archive, restore
assertionCoverage.clause: Retrying a client send with the same clientMessageId leaves exactly one Message.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production Message route is called twice with the same client id and the subsequent list reads exactly one durable Message.

assertionCoverage.name: direct Conversation lifecycle: create, send, list, archive, restore
assertionCoverage.clause: The idempotent retry remains a successful accepted Message request.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The second production HTTP request is observed as the same successful API operation before the exact-one list assertion.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-11-001 / LITE-09-001 / LITE-02-001 a Message-only Turn creates no Task and no Run
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(Number(admissions.n), 0, 'LITE-02-001: no modifying Run authority is taken by a Message-only Turn');
assertionCoverage.clause: A Message-only Turn takes no modifying Run authority.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production route is followed by a direct admission-ledger query that asserts no canonical Run authority was acquired.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-11-001 / LITE-09-001 / LITE-02-001 a Message-only Turn creates no Task and no Run
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(countRows('tasks'), 0, 'LITE-11-001: posting a Message creates no Task');
assertionCoverage.clause: Posting a Message creates no Task.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production Message POST is followed immediately by a durable tasks-table count before any explicit bridge action.

assertionCoverage.name: LITE-11-001 / LITE-09-001 / LITE-02-001 a Message-only Turn creates no Task and no Run
assertionCoverage.expression: assert.equal(countRows('runs'), 0, 'LITE-11-001: posting a Message creates no Run');
assertionCoverage.clause: Posting a Message creates no Run.
assertionCoverage.whyDirect: The production Message POST is followed immediately by a durable runs-table count before any explicit bridge action.

limitation: Counts are parsed only from a unique TAP summary; null means unparsed, never zero. Named test results remain in raw output. No acceptance promotion.
